scope: B05 N03 / B09 O13 connected partitioned ordinary lookup, index-join and index-merge table readers; existing-owner maintenance, no complete package acceptance
changes: The shared routed reader validates aligned physical IDs and selected partitions before I/O, groups handles by physical namespace and retains shared table-batch statement/estimate policy.

Row and typed-chunk completion retain original request positions; equal integer/common handles across partitions do not alias, unordered completion restores input order, and missing/filtered rows leave identity gaps.

Ordinary inline and persistent-worker lookups retain physical routes through remote completion, residual/adaptive filters and transaction-aware fallback. Chunk projection synthesizes physical ID from the matching route.

Index-join index iteration retains partition ordinals through window collection and both remote and local table readers. Index-merge HandleSourceExec uses original request positions for physical-ID output.

Partition-only remote bypasses, bare-handle cross-partition association and discarded join routes are removed. Unpartitioned readers retain their original mutable storage owner; staged cursor Drop closes all opened streams on later refusal/error. Dirty reads preserve their separate fallback.

baseline_results.reason: All three SQL outputs were correct, but none opened a policy-carrying remote table request.
